summary: Learn how to move between saved calculation time steps, select a specific moment of the simulation, and use automatic playback to review the results.
actions: Use the buttons on the Time Control panel to move to the first or last saved simulation step.
Use the backward and forward buttons to move five saved steps at a time.
Use the previous and next step buttons to review the saved simulation states one by one.
Click Time Scale, move the slider or enter the required value in the Time field, press Enter, and click OK.
Click Autoview of time steps On / Off to start or stop automatic playback from the currently displayed step.
expected: You can move between saved calculation steps, display a specific moment of the simulation, and start or stop automatic playback of the results.
